title: What a company's own law makes it state on its invoice, in the 17 countries the invoice pack covers
source: Each statute was read in its official text on 2026-10-10 and is enforced on an invoice only where its words reach an invoice: FR: Code de commerce art. R123-237 (version in force since 15 May 2022) and art. R123-238 (https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/codes/section_lc/LEGITEXT000005634379/LEGISCTA000006178891/); BE: Code des sociétés et des associations / Wetboek van vennootschappen en verenigingen art. 2:20 (https://www.ejustice.just.fgov.be/eli/wet/2019/03/23/2019A40586/justel); NL: Handelsregisterwet 2007 art. 27 (text in force from 16 July 2025); Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 2 art. 186 and art. 75 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0021777); ES: Código de Comercio art. 24.1 (BOE consolidated text, last updated 9 May 2023) (https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1885-6627); IT: Codice civile art. 2250 (text in force from 29 July 2009) and art. 2497-bis (https://www.normattiva.it/uri-res/N2Ls?urn:nir:stato:regio.decreto:1942-03-16;262); SE: Aktiebolagslagen (2005:551) 28 kap. 5 § (as amended up to SFS 2026:783) (https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-och-lagar/dokument/svensk-forfattningssamling/aktiebolagslag-2005551_sfs-2005-551/); NO: Bokføringsforskriften § 5-1-2; lov 20. juni 2025 nr. 106 om Foretaksregisteret § 7-2 (in force 1 January 2026; § 10-2 of the 1985 act before it) (https://lovdata.no/forskrift/2004-12-01-1558/§5-1-2); DK: Selskabsloven (lovbekendtgørelse nr. 331 af 20/03/2025) § 2, stk. 4 (https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2025/331); AU: Corporations Act 2001 s 153(1), (2) and s 88A(1)(c) (compilation C2026C00432, 19 September 2026) (https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2004A00818/latest/text); GB: The Company, Limited Liability Partnership and Business (Names and Trading Disclosures) Regulations 2015 (SI 2015/17) reg. 24(1)(e); reg. 25 (https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/17/regulation/24); IE: Companies Act 2014 s. 49(1)(b)(iii); s. 151 (as enacted) (https://www.irishstatutebook.ie/eli/2014/act/38/section/49/enacted/en/html); CA: Canada Business Corporations Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. C-44) s. 10(5), current to 21 September 2026 (https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/C-44/section-10.html); DE: GmbHG § 35a; AktG § 80; HGB § 37a (https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/gmbhg/__35a.html); AT: Unternehmensgesetzbuch § 14 (https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/NormDokument.wxe?Abfrage=Bundesnormen&Gesetzesnummer=10001702&Paragraf=14); PL: Kodeks spółek handlowych art. 206 § 1 and art. 374 § 1 (consolidated text of 3 June 2026); ustawa o Krajowym Rejestrze Sądowym art. 34 (https://isap.sejm.gov.pl/isap.nsf/DocDetails.xsp?id=WDU20000941037); FI: Yritys- ja yhteisötietolaki (244/2001) 15 § (https://www.finlex.fi/fi/lainsaadanto/2001/244); US: none. The French articles were read on Légifrance through a fetch that returns the page as text, items 1° and 2° of R123-237 word for word; every other text was read as served by its official site.
note: Unproved: the 2026-10-20 standards audit could not prove these 17 statutes against their official pages again; they stay as read on 2026-10-10 until each is.

rules.text: When the seller is a company of a form its country's statute names, the invoice page states each particular that statute puts on an invoice; a missing one fails with the article.
rules.source: The statutes of the rules ICP-FR to ICP-US below

rules.text: A particular the person's files do not give is never made up: the order lists it in the seller's "unknown", the page prints nothing in its place, and the check passes with a warning that the invoice is not complete without it. A number the tax rules ask for too cannot be declared unknown.
rules.source: skills/_checks/einvoice_particulars.py; skills/e-invoice/SKILL.md, The company's own particulars

rules.text: When a particular is declared unknown, the reply says which one, that the invoice is not complete without it, and asks the person for it.
rules.source: skills/e-invoice/SKILL.md, The company's own particulars

rules.text: A particular the person's own files give for the seller and the page does not state fails, whatever the order declares: the folder the check is told about, else the folder the page is in, is read.
rules.source: skills/_checks/einvoice_particulars.py (the wave 9 proof of 2026-10-09: a run that passed every rule while it had dropped the register entry and the share capital its notes gave)

rules.text: A French company registered at the RCS states on its invoices its SIREN, "RCS" with the city of its registry, the place of its seat and, when it is so, that it is in liquidation; its name stands with its legal form, and a SARL, SA, SAS, SCA or SE states the amount of its share capital (an SNC or SCS does not).
rules.source: Code de commerce art. R123-237 (version in force since 15 May 2022) and art. R123-238 (https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/codes/section_lc/LEGITEXT000005634379/LEGISCTA000006178891/)

rules.text: A Belgian legal person states on its invoices its name, its legal form, the precise seat, its enterprise number, "RPR" or "RPM" (rechtspersonenregister, registre des personnes morales) with the court of its seat, its e-mail address and website when it has them and, when it is so, that it is in liquidation.
rules.source: Code des sociétés et des associations / Wetboek van vennootschappen en verenigingen art. 2:20 (https://www.ejustice.just.fgov.be/eli/wet/2019/03/23/2019A40586/justel)

rules.text: A business entered in the Dutch trade register states its KvK number on its letters, orders, invoices and quotations; every document a BV or NV issues shows its full name and its seat (woonplaats).
rules.source: Handelsregisterwet 2007 art. 27 (text in force from 16 July 2025); Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 2 art. 186 and art. 75 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0021777)

rules.text: A Spanish company states on its documents, correspondence, order notes and invoices its domicile, the particulars that identify its entry in the Registro Mercantil, its legal form and, when it is so, that it is in liquidation; when it mentions its capital, the subscribed and the paid-up capital.
rules.source: Código de Comercio art. 24.1 (BOE consolidated text, last updated 9 May 2023) (https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1885-6627)

rules.text: An Italian company subject to registration states in its documents and correspondence (atti e corrispondenza) its seat, the register office where it is entered and its number there; an S.p.A., S.a.p.a. or S.r.l. its capital as paid up and shown in the last balance sheet; an S.p.A. or S.r.l. whether it has a sole shareholder; after dissolution, that it is in liquidation; and the company that directs and coordinates it. The article does not use the word invoice: an invoice is read as one of the company's atti.
rules.source: Codice civile art. 2250 (text in force from 29 July 2009) and art. 2497-bis (https://www.normattiva.it/uri-res/N2Ls?urn:nir:stato:regio.decreto:1942-03-16;262)

rules.text: A Swedish aktiebolag's letters, invoices and order forms state its name, the place where the board has its seat, its organisationsnummer and, when it is so, that it is in liquidation.
rules.source: Aktiebolagslagen (2005:551) 28 kap. 5 § (as amended up to SFS 2026:783) (https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-och-lagar/dokument/svensk-forfattningssamling/aktiebolagslag-2005551_sfs-2005-551/)

rules.text: The sales document of a Norwegian AS, ASA or branch of a foreign company carries the word Foretaksregisteret, the head office's address and, when it is so, that the company is being wound up; its business documents state the register, the organisational form and the head office.
rules.source: Bokføringsforskriften § 5-1-2; lov 20. juni 2025 nr. 106 om Foretaksregisteret § 7-2 (in force 1 January 2026; § 10-2 of the 1985 act before it) (https://lovdata.no/forskrift/2004-12-01-1558/§5-1-2)

rules.text: A Danish kapitalselskab states in its letters and other business papers its name, its hjemsted (the address in Denmark it can be reached at, § 5, nr. 14) and its CVR-nummer. The paragraph does not use the word invoice: an invoice is read as a business paper.
rules.source: Selskabsloven (lovbekendtgørelse nr. 331 af 20/03/2025) § 2, stk. 4 (https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2025/331)

rules.text: An Australian company sets out its name on its public documents, which include an invoice, and with the name "ACN" and its Australian Company Number, or "ABN" and its Australian Business Number when that number's last nine digits are the ACN.
rules.source: Corporations Act 2001 s 153(1), (2) and s 88A(1)(c) (compilation C2026C00432, 19 September 2026) (https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2004A00818/latest/text)

rules.text: A UK company discloses its registered name on its invoices. Its registered number, the part of the UK it is registered in and its registered office are asked on business letters, order forms and websites only, so they are not enforced on an invoice.
rules.source: The Company, Limited Liability Partnership and Business (Names and Trading Disclosures) Regulations 2015 (SI 2015/17) reg. 24(1)(e); reg. 25 (https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/17/regulation/24)

rules.text: An Irish company has its name on all its invoices. Its place of registration, number, registered office and directors are asked on business letters and order forms only, so they are not enforced on an invoice.
rules.source: Companies Act 2014 s. 49(1)(b)(iii); s. 151 (as enacted) (https://www.irishstatutebook.ie/eli/2014/act/38/section/49/enacted/en/html)

rules.text: A corporation under the federal act sets out its name in legible characters in its invoices. The provincial acts were not read.
rules.source: Canada Business Corporations Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. C-44) s. 10(5), current to 21 September 2026 (https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/C-44/section-10.html)

rules.text: Not enforced on an invoice. A German GmbH, AG or registered merchant states its legal form, seat, register court and number and its directors on business letters to a named recipient and on order forms; the paragraphs do not name invoices and exempt form messages within a standing business relationship.
rules.source: GmbHG § 35a; AktG § 80; HGB § 37a (https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/gmbhg/__35a.html)

rules.text: Not enforced on an invoice. An Austrian registered business states its firm, legal form, seat, Firmenbuchnummer and Firmenbuch court on business letters, order forms and websites.
rules.source: Unternehmensgesetzbuch § 14 (https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/NormDokument.wxe?Abfrage=Bundesnormen&Gesetzesnummer=10001702&Paragraf=14)

rules.text: Not enforced on an invoice. A Polish sp. z o.o. or S.A. states its name, seat and address, the registry court and its number, its NIP and its share capital on letters and commercial orders (pisma i zamówienia handlowe) and on its website; the register act asks the same of written statements to named persons.
rules.source: Kodeks spółek handlowych art. 206 § 1 and art. 374 § 1 (consolidated text of 3 June 2026); ustawa o Krajowym Rejestrze Sądowym art. 34 (https://isap.sejm.gov.pl/isap.nsf/DocDetails.xsp?id=WDU20000941037)

rules.text: Not enforced on an invoice. A Finnish registered business states its business ID on its letters and forms (kirjeet ja lomakkeet), and an osakeyhtiö also its registered name, domicile, address and any liquidation.
rules.source: Yritys- ja yhteisötietolaki (244/2001) 15 § (https://www.finlex.fi/fi/lainsaadanto/2001/244)

rules.text: Not enforced. No federal statute sets a company's particulars on an invoice; state law was not read.
rules.source: none
